dedupe_keys.name: ai4ef machine learning tool for building energy retrofit and pv decisions enershare

description: AI4EF (Artificial Intelligence for Energy Efficiency) is a user-centric tool for building energy retrofit and efficiency decisions, developed in the Enershare project. It uses machine learning to let public sector staff, energy consultants and building owners model and predict energy consumption, retrofit costs and environmental impacts of upgrades, with modules for building retrofitting, photovoltaic installation assessment and predictive modelling, plus a Training Playground for data scientists to refine the models. It connects to the Enershare data space and uses Keycloak for identity management. Coverage: models trained on the project's building data, aimed at European users. Access: code on GitHub with a Zenodo DOI, delivered as Docker images with an API; the README lists entry points such as an investment-planning classifier and a PV forecasting service. Licence: GPL 3.0. Caveats: predictions depend on the training data, which may not transfer to other building stocks, and the data space features need an Enershare connection. Simulation uses: screening retrofit packages and rooftop PV at portfolio scale. Related records: EnergyPlus, BESOS and ResStock.
